name: AKU Faculty wins Prestigious Publons Award

content.title: AKU Faculty wins Prestigious Publons Award
content.summary: Dr Ahmed Sarki from SONAM urges academics to indulge in peer reviewing

media.alt: AKU Faculty wins Prestigious Publons Award

content.text: Dr Ahmed Sarki, a Faculty member at The Aga Khan University's (AKU) School of Nursing and Midwifery is a winner of a Publons' 2018 global Peer Review Awards.
Dr Ahmed won a Publons award for placing within the top 1% of reviewers globally in the Multidisciplinary Category.

The awards, announced during this year's Peer Review Week, celebrate reviewers as the Sentinels of Science and research, tirelessly proving their unwavering commitment towards the quality and integrity of scholarly communication.

Publons offers a free service for academics to track, verify and showcase their peer review and editorial contributions for academic journals. The website has more than 200,000 researchers and more than one million reviews across 25,000 journals.

Speaking after the announcement, Dr Sarki acknowledged Publons' role in enabling academics to record, track, and verify peer-reviewed contributions and urged all academics to set up a Publons account and contribute to peer review activity.

'To the best of my knowledge, it is the most recognized platform by academics, editors, and publishers striving to ensure transparency in editorial or peer-review processes' said Dr Sarki who set up his Publons account in December 2016, has reviewed for 9 journals and has 21 pre-publication reviews

'The award is a testament that the efforts and hard work invested in scholarly peer-review are recognized and rewarded. I must also say a big thanks to the Dean AKU SONAM East Africa Prof Sharon Brownie for supporting me and opening peer-reviewing opportunities for all academics in the region' he added.

'I learn a lot from peer-reviewing as the process helps me improve my academic writing and analytical skills' said Dr Sarki, who graduated in 2017 from the University of Warwick, United Kingdom with a PhD in Medicine (Epidemiology & Biostatistics).

Publons Peer Review Awards honor the elite contributors to scholarly peer review and editorial pursuits internationally with 6,000 being honored in this year's Peer Review Awards. Recipients demonstrate an outstanding expert commitment to protecting the integrity and accuracy of published research in their field.
